decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted 18th May 2017 and numbered Location plan (unnumbered, scaled at 1:1250) and location plan (unnumbered, scaled at 1:200), RA275/01, 02, 03, 04, 05 and 06, and submitted 26th July 2017 and numbered RA275/07DS, 08DS, 10DS, 11DS, 12DS and 13DS, therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - The window at first floor level within the rear elevation of the proposed side extension shall be obscure glazed and non-openable up to a 1.7 metres above internal floor level and permanently retained as such.
description: Erection of a two storey side extension and a single storey rear extension
